evidence_family: material ontology and prediction eligibility
geographic_scope: India
gap_description: Ontology coverage is much broader than prediction eligibility and validated scoring support.
quantitative_evidence: 254 ontology entities; 50 model targets; 34 with MRDS evidence; 20 with percentiles; 15 spatially validated; 14 passing minimum holdout AUC.
scientific_or_operational_impact: Most catalogued materials cannot receive defensible rankings.
current_mitigation: Unsupported materials remain explicitly unscored.
resolution_evidence_required: Independent coordinate-bearing positives and deposit-type labels sufficient for spatial holdout.
model_effect: No automatic score is created from ontology membership.

evidence_family: known sites
geographic_scope: India selection
gap_description: The primary coordinate-bearing known-site layer is not an exhaustive or current statutory mine register.
quantitative_evidence: 781 records; 779 within expected India bounds; two retained out-of-bounds source coordinates.
scientific_or_operational_impact: Label incompleteness and positional error can bias training and evaluation.
current_mitigation: Source quality codes, raw coordinates, bounds flags, and limitations remain published.
resolution_evidence_required: Authoritative, reusable national mine/occurrence register with dated status and coordinate accuracy.
model_effect: Model training uses these points with spatial holdout but cannot correct missing positives.

evidence_family: mine and concession status
geographic_scope: India; published administrative geography
gap_description: KHANAN does not have a controlling nationwide current operating, title, clearance, suspension, or closure register linked to exact geometries.
quantitative_evidence: 1,353 latest inspected identities; 82 abandoned-mine rows; 97 IBM auction rows; zero rows asserted as currently legally or operationally verified.
scientific_or_operational_impact: No operational recommendation or current-status claim can be made.
current_mitigation: Event types and dates remain separate; unverified current status is explicit.
resolution_evidence_required: Dated controlling lease, clearance, production, suspension, and closure sources joined by stable mine/lease identifiers.
model_effect: Status-context rows are excluded from spatial scoring.

evidence_family: analytical geochemistry
geographic_scope: Two western-Assam sites
gap_description: Redistributable coordinate-bearing analytical geochemistry is extremely sparse and targeted.
quantitative_evidence: 13 samples, two coordinate sites, and 1,323 observations.
scientific_or_operational_impact: The layer cannot validate national anomalies or regional grade continuity.
current_mitigation: It remains independent context outside training and validation.
resolution_evidence_required: Systematic India-wide measurements with method, detection limit, medium, depth, uncertainty, and reusable coordinates.
model_effect: No score or candidate rank changes.

evidence_family: NGDR/GSI geoscience services
geographic_scope: Nominal national coverage
gap_description: NGDR feature values are not redistributed because dataset-specific reuse authority and essential unit/method metadata are unresolved.

resolution_evidence_required: Dataset-specific written reuse basis plus complete coordinate, unit, analytical-method, scale, and missingness metadata.
model_effect: NGDR values remain excluded from model training and scoring.

evidence_family: Sentinel-2 surface context
